description: Poll or wait on a background job (qa_test_this, qa_prepare_target, qa_explore, qa_build run, ...): status, progressDetail, and result/error when finished (qa_test_this: state completed/blocked/unsafe/needs_input, reportUri, suite, smoke, health). waitMs long-polls until the job leaves "running" (else waited.timedOut:true).

waitMs.description: Block up to this many ms for the job to finish (use 45000; capped at SWIPIUM_MAX_WAIT_MS, default 50000). Default 0 = return immediately.

name: qa_job_status
title: Job status (optionally wait)
